recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the Applied FHIR-45063 restructure by removing stale current conformance references without revisiting the already-audited later notConsumedItem decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-45063 was an Applied OO R6 change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking to address that the old consumedItem backbone also carried notConsumed data. The approved resolution was to separate consumed and not-consumed content under a NutritionItem backbone.
initial_application: The main model change appears to have been applied through untagged NutritionIntake commits. Commit 3ac16a4386440da295918dd1c6900c7e9ee11f16 updated the nutrition SearchParameter expression to NutritionIntake.nutritionItem.nutritionProduct.concept but left adjacent path metadata and description stale. Commit a3233204b1e31daacbe54d0a49da7a49f66ca37c introduced the new nutritionItem structure. Commit 05e646d74bb93a1c435d884747dc64da94898435 later refined the not-consumed side into notConsumedItem.
additional_context: NutritionIntake is active in the current build and assigned to OO in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issues FHIR-47247 and FHIR-48727 are already represented on the combined branch and confirm the current notConsumedItem backbone, so this seed fix preserves that later model. The remaining old-path references in the introduction ballot note and fhir.ini version-diff mappings are historical context and were intentionally left unchanged.
reconciliation: Published a non-empty source commit changing the NutritionIntake.code binding description to point to nutritionItem and aligning the NutritionIntake nutrition SearchParameter build path metadata plus description with NutritionIntake.nutritionItem.nutritionProduct.concept.
source_changes: source/nutritionintake/structuredefinition-NutritionIntake.xml: changed the NutritionIntake.code binding description from "See consumedItem" to "See nutritionItem".

source/nutritionintake/bundle-NutritionIntake-search-params.xml: changed the nutrition SearchParameter build path metadata from the removed root consumedItem path to NutritionIntake.nutritionItem.nutritionProduct.concept and updated the description from consumed item to nutrition product.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue clarified the modifier concern after the NutritionIntake reorganization; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Later Applied issue moved not-consumed details into a notConsumedItem backbone; it is already represented on the combined branch and shaped the wording choice.
Same NutritionIntake meeting family concerning value-set cleanup; it is already audited separately and did not require a source change for this seed.
